download_uci_datasets: download all UCI datasets to a specified directory path
download_letter_dataset: download the letter recognition dataset from UCI archive to a given path
download_pendigits_dataset: download the pendigits handwritten digits dataset from UCI archive to a given path
download_satimage_dataset: download the satimage landsat satellite dataset from UCI archive to a given path
download_yeast_dataset: download the yeast dataset from UCI archive to a given path
